events.title: Spinouts begone!
events.summary: 10/23/2026 ---handling--- Somewhat big change: aimed towards making spinouts easier to recover Default steering wheel: up to half as heavy and twice as quick only when sliding/drifting/spinning-out (feeling is completely unchanged in normal cornering) ---fixes--- Grab tolerance can now be set up to 2.5xThe horn's grab area is smaller, so it is harder to honk by accident10/22/2026---handling--- Pneumatic servo reworked to make catching slides easier: its wheel can be dragged twice as quick during

events.title: Demo small update: tweaks & fixes
events.summary: A new demo update is live!GeneralNew main rival: Iowa. There's also now a chance some main rivals (e.g. Nirdox) won't spawn in a race, for more varietyNew "Match cursor sensitivity" button beside hand sensitivity: sets your hand sensitivity to match your desktop cursorSoundtracks: Adjusted EQ on some music tracks (Stadium and Factory) to sound more livelyBalanceSawed-Off and Rubberjumper: tighter pellet spread and sound adjustmentsPneumatic Servo: self-aligns more gently, so it fights your steer

events.title: Demo Out Now !
events.summary: Start your engines, DEMO IS OUT !!!Featuring:A full roguelike run: a branching map 7 races long with 3 lives, objectives, and a shop between races.71 items to collect, each with unique abilities: use them to obliterate your enemies, gain lap time, or even turn back time.10 race setups across 5 tracks: Stadium, Forest, Winter Mountain, Fire Factory and Tokyo, each with its own weather or time of day, featuring mirrored and reversed layouts.15 Achievements to unlock.
